questions.question: Use highlight_top_n in order to know What are the sales patterns and pricing differences among different coffee types?

answer.value: Based on the data analysis, coffee sales show distinct pricing tiers. Premium-priced coffees (Hot Chocolate, Cappuccino, Latte, Cocoa) average around 35-36 per cup, while mid-tier options (Americano with Milk) average 30.59, and budget options (Americano, Cortado, Espresso) range from 20.85-25.98. Latte is the top seller by volume with 757 transactions generating 26,875.30 in revenue. Sales are evenly distributed across time periods: Afternoon (1,205 transactions), Morning (1,181), and Night (1,161), with Night having the highest average transaction value (32.89). The data suggests customers prefer premium coffee options regardless of time of day.
